title: TOOLS-004: The RAW-to-FITS utility has fragile file handling
description:
TOOLS-004: The RAW-to-FITS utility has fragile file handling. `write()` is treated as a one-shot full write, input allocation/reallocation is unchecked, `fseek()`/`ftell()` and `fread()` failures are ignored, and each glob pattern is evaluated repeatedly in separate `glob()` calls before `globfree()`. This can mis-handle partial I/O, leave uninitialized data in conversions, or leak glob state. Use checked `size_t` file sizes, loop until all output bytes are written, call `glob()` once per pattern, and check all I/O results. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.
